title: Localizzazione causale delle code lente, prima di altro training

hypotheses.arithmetic: FP32 recurrent rounding accounts for the tail timing errors: learned64 rescues them using identical learned coefficients.
hypotheses.equilibrium: Biased learned equilibrium dominates: oracle_u rescues more baseline failures than oracle_z without adding regressions.
hypotheses.relaxation: Biased learned update fraction dominates: oracle_z rescues more failures than oracle_u without adding regressions.
hypotheses.accumulation: Small local errors accumulate: teacher_previous/reset controls rescue failures that persist in learned64.
hypotheses.interaction: Both coefficient errors interact: neither single oracle rescues a case but oracle_both does.
hypotheses.sensitivity: Very shallow current crossings amplify small current errors into long offset delays; inspect crossing slopes and per-channel oracle rescues. This does not waive timing gates.

success: Exact replay of archived baseline, complete per-case causal contrasts including regressions, oracle-both identity and immutable weights. This is information gain only; model improvement requires a subsequent non-oracle repair passing all original quality/stress/regression/cost gates.
stop: Any input/hash/baseline replay mismatch or nonfinite stops technical execution, not scientific rejection. Max90minutes. No training before causal attribution.
limits: All41n stress data are opened diagnostic data, not an independent confirmation.
No oracle or periodically reset state is deployable or selectable.
No information-insufficiency claim follows from a one-step improvement alone.
Original FP32 floor failures remain explicit; no precision-policy release change.
This stage does not measure a new speedup or authorize42; repair and independent confirmation remain separate gates.

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.
